jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Commodity Manager (f/m/d) CD & NUC, you will shape the sourcing strategy for some of Siemens Energy’s most advanced technology categories, including electronic equipment, controls, digitalization, and nuclear services. Working closely with engineering, quality, and project teams, you will build resilient supplier partnerships, negotiate complex commercial agreements, and ensure a secure, cost-effective supply chain that supports global business growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute global sourcing and category strategies for electronic equipment, controls, and digital technologies
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers through market analysis, spend optimization, and cross-functional collaboration
* Build long-term partnerships with key suppliers while driving performance through KPIs, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Lead supplier development programs to strengthen quality, capability, and supply chain resilience in technically complex and regulated environments
* Negotiate complex commercial contracts, including pricing, intellectual property, and long-term service agreements, to maximize value and minimize risk
* Proactively assess supply chain risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity across global procurement activities

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics or a comparable technical or business discipline
* Extensive experience in strategic procurement, sourcing, or category management with a strong focus on electronic equipment and technical commodities
* Proven expertise in managing complex supplier relationships, supplier development, and procurement projects within regulated or high-technology industries
* Strong commercial acumen with advanced contract negotiation, contract management, and risk mitigation capabilities
* Analytical and strategic mindset with excellent stakeholder management skills; knowledge of AI applications and procurement automation is a plus
* Business fluent in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Controller / Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will be the financial lead for a portfolio of complex real estate construction projects within Siemens Energy. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting
* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives
* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle
* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project execution

What You Bring

* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage
* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects
* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation
* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules
* Business fluent English communication skills

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
AI is the largest platform shift since the cloud itself, and the companies who move first will define their industries for a decade. AWS Enterprise works with the organizations making those moves: global brands, energy leaders, mobility operators, insurers, retailers. The AI Strategic Pursuits team leads the most strategic AI opportunities across these accounts, from the first board conversation to signed agreement and production impact.
As an AI Strategic Pursuit Lead, you own the commercial motion behind transformational AI initiatives. You operate inside the account team alongside Account Executives, Solutions Architects and Specialists, and you own the AI opportunity end to end: shaping the executive narrative, building the business case, orchestrating stakeholders across customer C-suites and AWS leadership, and driving deals through to close. You are the person a CEO calls when they decide AI is a board priority rather than an experiment.
This is not a program management role and not a technical role. It is a commercial leadership role for people who translate ambiguity into strategy, strategy into a deal, and a deal into measurable customer outcomes.
Role is based out of Munich, Germany; responsibilities will cover segments and regions across the Germany, Switzerland and CEE area.

Key job responsibilities
Own a portfolio of strategic AI pursuits across Germany, Switzerland and CEE's largest enterprise accounts, with direct accountability for pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Build and present board-level business cases: value quantification, transformation roadmaps, investment logic.
Lead executive engagement from first briefing through negotiation, including C-suite workshops, executive briefings, and multi-stakeholder alignment
Bring together the right programs and investment vehicles to advance AI transformation at scale at customers.
Shape large, multi-year agreements together with Account Teams, including commercial structure and executive sponsorship.
Turn wins into references: document outcomes and bring customer stories to industry stages
Feed field insight back into the AWS AI go-to-market strategy and mechanisms and drive repeatability of AWS AI transformation approach to help customers adopt AI safely and at scale.

A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the team
AI Strategic Pursuits is a new team inside AWS Enterprise Sales, built to match the moment. We hire people with bar raising depth and drive who chose the field over the deck, enterprise sellers who closed the deals others called impossible, operators who built businesses inside large organizations. We are small by design, senior by default, and measured on outcomes our customers announce publicly.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working closely with and advising senior executives of an organization or equivalent
- Track record leading large, complex deals or transformation initiatives from origination to signature
- Experience building business cases and value narratives for board-level audiences
- Bar raising in senior stakeholder management and communication
- Fluent in English (verbally, in writing)

Preferred qualifications

- Background at a top-tier strategy consultancy combined with commercial line experience
- Experience selling or advising on AI, data, or cloud transformation on senior executive level
- Experience operating in matrixed global organizations with distributed decision making

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.
